sent_works.body:
Nice to meet you, Kanda-sama. I really love your art style, especially the balance of the faces!
I’m sending this request because I’d love for you to draw my friend’s and my original characters, if you’d be willing. (I’ve already gotten my friend’s permission for this.)
I’d really appreciate it if you could consider this!

​───

Adventurers from the TRPG scenario “DOGMA.” A hitman duo. The setting is a modern-day Japan with poor public safety—specifically, the slums.

◾︎ Gokushiki – The Man with Lead-Colored Hair
184 cm / 23 years old
In the past, someone dear to him was killed by “Heaven” (the man described below). Since then, he has continued to hone his skills as an assassin to take revenge on him.
His goal is to show “Heaven” what “Hell” is like.

◾︎Heaven—The Blond-Haired Man
177 cm / 27 years old
A smirking, elusive man. He has absolute confidence in himself.
Rather than killing the Shiki, who persistently targets his life, he has recognized Shiki’s usefulness, keeps him by his side, and could even be said to look after him to some extent.

✧ Relationship
・No emotional bond. They’ve joined forces for mutual benefit (work/revenge).

✧ Art Style
I’ll leave everything—expressions, composition, situations, etc.—entirely up to you. Feel free to choose or omit any clothing details from the reference materials as you see fit. I’d appreciate it if you could draw him in a way that’s easiest for you.

✧ Intended Use
In addition to sharing among friends,
・Posting on social media (with the artist credited), using as an icon or header, or as reference material when commissioning others
・Creating personal merchandise
may be possible.

​───

If the price doesn’t seem right or there are any issues with the instructions, please feel free to cancel or ask for a resend. Thank you for your cooperation!
